credits: Painted from family photos of Olivia, Zero, Belle, and home.
title: Olivia and the Yard Romp
subtitle: Red clay, two tails, one laugh.
blurb: Olivia bursts onto the red-clay yard with Belle racing ahead and Zero trotting behind. Patio chairs, a green shed, and woods full of wind.

magic.home: Red clay on the shoes. Two tails. One laugh.

pages.heading: The door opens
pages.text: The black door on the little wooden deck swung wide. {Olivia:olivia/run} jumped down to the red clay. "Come on!" The {yard} was waiting.

pages.heading: Belle races
pages.text: {Belle:belle/run} was already a black streak across the clay. Tan legs flying. Tail like a flag. {Olivia:olivia/run} laughed so hard she had to run to keep up.

pages.heading: Zero follows
pages.text: {Zero:zero/run} did not race. She trotted, calm, because older sisters do. She kept one eye on Belle and one eye on {Olivia}. That is a job too.

pages.heading: Around the chairs
pages.text: They looped the wooden chairs. They passed the picnic table. They sniffed the oval garden bed. The {yard} was a whole world, and it was theirs.

pages.heading: The woods watch
pages.text: Green woods stood all around, like a quiet fence. {Olivia:olivia/ask} waved at them. {Belle:belle/wag} barked once at a bird. {Zero:zero/wag} sat, queen of the clay.

pages.heading: Back to the deck
pages.text: Shoes full of red dust. Two tails wagging. One laugh left. They climbed the little deck. {Home} smelled like dinner and couch. The romp was done — until tomorrow.

end.heading: The End
end.text: You {read} the whole {story}. The yard is red clay, green woods, and room to run.
end.prompt: If you ran a romp, who would race, and who would trot?

questions.right: Yes. Belle is a black streak.

questions.q: What color is the yard dirt?
Who keeps one eye on everyone?
questions.right: Zero is the older sister. That is her job.
